svg.aria-label: The Ticketmaster data model: the City, Cinema, Cinema_Hall, Cinema_Seat chain on the left, the Movie, Show, Show_Seat, Booking chain on the right, with User and Payment

g.text: each cinema is in one city
each hall belongs to one cinema
each seat sits in one hall
one row per seat per show
a show runs in one hall

svg.text: processed by the external financial service
step 6 watches this table to expire holds
every reservation writes Show_Seat and Booking; 20 million seat records arrive per day
the five-minute hold is a Status and a Timestamp in Booking, not an open database lock
